blockingIssues.description: Session re-login occurs in a temporary context, but registration continues on the original context/page, so expired-session recovery can still proceed unauthenticated.
Unknown-field detection treats almost all unmatched visible inputs as required (`if is_required or field_type != "hidden"`), causing optional custom fields to incorrectly block registration.
Voice-agent `register_event` depends on an inbound `auth_token` message that the current frontend flow does not emit, so `/api/register` cannot be reliably called in the shipped flow.
For API HTTP 401/400/non-200 responses, `register_event` returns without sending a terminal registration result message to the frontend data channel.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a protocol consistency checklist requirement: when adding/changing any data-channel message type or payload keys, update both producer/consumer implementations in the same feature and verify the key names match the contract.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: registration-api-endpoint review found contract drift (`event_id` in mission guidance vs `event_url` in implementation) and an undocumented `auth_token` dependency not emitted by frontend flow.

rejectedObservations.observation: A new inbound `auth_token` message type was introduced but not reflected in shared protocol docs.
rejectedObservations.reason: implementation-fix-preferred: this is primarily a blocking product bug in current flow and should be addressed in code before adopting as shared guidance
